summary: Phase A code-first inventory for the first Feed/Search/Map route-runtime split. The safe first slice is to keep the existing Feed renderer static for exact startup parity, move the already-lazy Search/Map discovery controller boundary out of app-controller-bridge into a Feed/Search/Map route runtime module, and register the Feed/Search/Map route runtime entries through the Social Route Runtime Registry. No UI, CSS, DOM IDs/classes, Firebase paths, route parsing, header, shell, Public/Menu/QR, Heart, Staff, Chat, Waiter/Kitchen, or businessAccounts behavior should change.

existingDynamicImports.purpose: Dynamic import callback passed to startup bootstrap.

routeRuntimeRegistryCurrentUse.currentBehavior: Synchronous route key resolver and renderer map. Feed, search, and map entries are plain render functions supplied from social-app.js. renderMainCore delegates to routeRuntimeRegistry.renderActiveRoute() when a registry exists.
routeRuntimeRegistryCurrentUse.currentLimit: The registry does not own route runtime preload/loader metadata, so Search/Map lazy discovery loading is hidden in app-controller-bridge and Feed/Search/Map renderer grouping is still wired inline in social-app.js.

safeDynamicImportCandidates.candidate: Move discovery-runtime-controller.js dynamic import ownership from app-controller-bridge into a Feed/Search/Map route runtime module.
safeDynamicImportCandidates.reason: Search/Map discovery runtime is already lazy, and moving the loader boundary preserves existing renderSearchView/renderMapView, existing deferred fallback markup, existing Firebase reads, and existing Leaflet behavior.

safeDynamicImportCandidates.candidate: Add Feed/Search/Map route runtime entries to the registry.
safeDynamicImportCandidates.reason: Registry can own route preload/render metadata while still calling the exact bridge-provided renderers.

safeDynamicImportCandidates.candidate: Pass Feed/Search/Map route runtimes from the bridge bundle into createSocialRouteRuntimeRegistry instead of wiring feed/search/map renderers inline in social-app.js.
safeDynamicImportCandidates.reason: Reduces social-app.js renderer grouping and makes route runtime ownership explicit without changing renderMainCore or shell/header behavior.

unsafeToMoveNow.reason: Feed/home is the default first screen. Lazily replacing it would require a new visible loading state or a startup await. That is not safe under exact Feed UI parity.

unsafeToMoveNow.item: renderMainCore, renderHeader, renderBusinessTopTabs, drawer/header shell code
unsafeToMoveNow.reason: The previous public light-entry attempt broke UI by not reusing the exact shell/header/render/event path. This step must not change it.
createAppShellRuntimeController(...).bindSearchEvents is the event handler of record and must remain unchanged.
Changing Leaflet load/cleanup/marker behavior would risk map regressions. The safe slice only relocates the loader boundary.
Search remote queries and Feed/Map data loading must remain behaviorally identical.

unsafeToMoveNow.item: Public/Menu/QR, Heart CRM, /staff, businessAccounts, Chat, Waiter/Kitchen

exactImplementationPlan: Add apps/menyra-social/core/app-shell/feed-search-map-runtime.js as a small route runtime module.

Move normalizeDeferredDiscoveryCoords, buildRestaurantLocationsFallback, createDiscoveryRuntimeControllerAsync, ensureDiscoveryRuntimeController, queueDiscoveryRuntimeControllerLoad, renderDeferredDiscoveryView, and discoveryBridge from app-controller-bridge.js into feed-search-map-runtime.js.
Have feed-search-map-runtime.js delegate Feed render/update/bind functions to the existing createFeedViewOrchestrationController instance passed in from app-controller-bridge.js.

Have feed-search-map-runtime.js delegate Search/Map render/refresh/Leaflet/build-location functions to the existing createDiscoveryRuntimeController(...) methods after lazy import, preserving the existing deferred Search/Map fallback while loading.

Expose routeRuntimes.feed, routeRuntimes.search, and routeRuntimes.map from the new module. The feed runtime uses the existing Feed renderer. The search/map runtimes preload the existing discovery controller and render through the existing discovery renderers.

Enhance route-runtime-registry.js to accept routeRuntimes and prefer their render/preload hooks for feed/search/map while preserving current fallback renderers and public/staff/businessAccounts/default route behavior.
Pass bridgeShellRuntimeCluster.routeRuntimes into createSocialRouteRuntimeRegistry from social-app.js and remove inline feed/search/map renderer ownership from the registry call.
Keep renderMainCore, shell-ui-runtime-cluster renderMain, header rendering, Search binder, Feed binder, Firebase APIs, and Leaflet code unchanged.
expectedBundleImpact: discovery-runtime-controller.js remains a lazy Vite chunk, now loaded through the Feed/Search/Map route runtime boundary instead of directly inside app-controller-bridge.js.
social-app.js loses inline Feed/Search/Map registry renderer grouping and no longer directly owns those route entries.
Feed renderer code likely remains in the initial bundle in this first slice because moving it would risk changing the default /feed first render.
Search/Map startup coupling improves structurally because registry route entries can preload/load the discovery runtime explicitly.
